items.description: Gives Neuro a small knowledge graph that lasts between sessions: entities, relations and observations, searchable. Its tools appear to Neuro as mcp_memory_* actions once Vedal enables this extension.
launch_hints: Installs disabled. Vedal turns it on in the Extensions page; Neuro cannot start it herself.
Runs @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory 2026.8.31 through npx, so Node.js and network access are needed on first start.
Set MEMORY_FILE_PATH in the bridge's environment to choose where memory is saved. The bridge passes only that one variable to the server.
items.name: MCP Memory
